notes.text: The Pappa dossier preserves the same Mesharshya patronym. Its adjacent Pesachim and Gittin notices concern another clause and do not supply this name’s exact primary locus.
The separately listed entry preserves Ravin bar Rav Acha as a heading without biographical details.
Exact underlying passage remains open. Compared the local Pappa dossier, Gittin 32b, Pesachim 105a, and Bava Batra 82a, which names a Mesharshya son of Rav Chiyya.

Ravin’s patronym remains explicitly questioned. Entry 164 records Acha and proposes Adda in Pesachim 34a, where the checked digital Bavli text did not yield that chain. Chullin 97a includes Ravin bar Rav Adda, with a distinct reported name in Ritva, and does not establish the reading here.
